messages:
incidentbot: 🚨 Paging: High tail latency observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2; p95 increased from ~120ms → ~1.2s at 21:14 UTC. Trigger: latency-slo-breach. Incident channel created.

mike_eng: ack, looking. @kyle_oncall are you oncall?

kyle_oncall: oncall here — saw the alerts, taking lead. can someone share a quick impact snapshot?

sara_sre: From metrics: p50 95ms -> 200ms, p95 120ms -> 1.2s, error rate +0.2%. Traffic steady. Spill across several model shards. collecting spans now.

ana_ml: I pulled a few traces (sampling): trace:abc123, trace:def456. KV cache miss rate spiked around 21:11. Also seeing increased sched_switch events in spans.

chris_support: customer impact: two enterprise customers on Dedicated experiencing slow responses. Roughly ~3% of calls >1s. CS standing by to notify if we need a public status update.

mike_eng: mitigation attempt: starting a temporary fallback to smaller quantized variant v1.2q on canary. curl command used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/rollout -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"v1.2q","percent":20}'`

kyle_oncall: :thumbsup: confirm canary traffic shifted. monitoring latency and errors.

sara_sre: collecting kernel perf counters from the host pool. Command run: ```sudo perf stat -e context-switches,cpu-migrations,page-faults -a sleep 10``` output uploaded: https://s3.redwood/incident/5223456789/perf.txt

ana_ml: from perf.txt: page-faults spiked ~4x on affected nodes. traces show bursts of minor faults. Hypothesis: regression from recent kernel backport (linux-5.10.102 -> 5.10.105) applied last night.

mike_eng: can someone grab dmesg and kube events for 21:00-21:20? `kubectl get events --all-namespaces --since=20m`

kyle_oncall: grabbed dmesg: https://s3.redwood/incident/5223456789/dmesg.log — repeated mm_fault messages and elevated minor-fault logs; not seeing full OOM kills but heavy minor page activity.

chris_support: CS draft for status: "We are investigating increased tail latency for text generation in us-west-2. A fallback variant has been applied and we are monitoring. No data loss. Next update in 15m." OK to post?

kyle_oncall: post it. mention enterprise customers affected and that support will reach out to POCs.

sara_sre: for the RCA we should assemble a short timeline: kernel patch deploys (20:30), autoscaler churn (20:45), tail latency onset (21:12), mitigation canary (21:18). add any related logs to the trace bundle: https://s3.redwood/incident/5223456789/trace-bundle.tgz

ana_ml: i'll correlate KV cache miss timestamps with trace spans and upload CSV: https://s3.redwood/incident/5223456789/kv-miss.csv

mike_eng: next steps: 1) keep canary fallback at 20% while validating. 2) collect full perf traces from 3 affected hosts. 3) if correlation holds, plan rollback of kernel backport on candidate nodes. 4) post interim RCA + timeline in ~2h. who owns the rollback?

kyle_oncall: i'll own rollback plan & coordinate with eng-infra. tagging @sara_sre to drive perf trace collection.

sara_sre: collecting full perf traces now. ETA ~12m.

incidentbot: Incident update: mitigation applied (fallback variant). observed p95 on canary drop from ~1.2s -> ~320ms. continuing to monitor.

kyle_oncall: handoff note: i'm leading for the next 30m; after that @mike_eng will take over. keep customer comms every 30m. saving timeline & logs under incident folder.

chris_support: posted status to status.redwood.com and emailed affected customers. keeping support channel open for escalations.

mike_eng: thanks all. once stabilized, save timeline + artifacts and i'll start the RCA skeleton. please annotate any hypothesis with confidence level (low/medium/high) in the bundle.
